From: Priya Sen <priya.sen@luminahc.com>

Cc: Andrew Miller <andrew.miller@luminahc.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Traffic quarantine & automatic pin request — Lumina Health rollout

Hi Rachel,

We started the phased rollout of the fresher model (v3.2-opt) across production yesterday and are seeing sustained p95 tail latency regressions in Region us-west: ~480–520ms for a subset of requests, plus a 2.4% increase in 5xxs (most appear transient but correlated with longer contexts). Attached are samples and a snapshot from our telemetry.

Given our SLA commitment (99.9% uptime, p95 < 400ms for the primary endpoints), we need a short-term operational allowance: can Redwood enable a traffic quarantine (isolate the affected cohort to the stable model) and configure an automatic pin to the stable model if p95 > 450ms for 10 continuous minutes or error rate delta > 1.5%? We want this to be automatic to prevent customer impact while we investigate.

We plan to keep the quarantine in place until we validate fixes (estimated 48 hours max). Please confirm which controls you can enable immediately and what data/audit trail you will capture for our compliance team.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sen
CTO, Lumina Health
Attachments: latency-samples.csv (csv), prod-telemetry-snapshot.json (json)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sen <priya.sen@luminahc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Traffic quarantine & automatic pin request — Lumina Health rollout

Hi Priya — thanks for the detailed data and the quick heads-up. We can absolutely put guardrails in place immediately. Proposed short-term mitigation (can enable within ~15 minutes after you give the go-ahead):

- Traffic quarantine: carve the affected cohort (by request path + header token) and route 100% of that cohort to the stable model (v3.1-stable).
- Auto-pin policy: pin to v3.1-stable when either: p95 > 450ms for 10 continuous minutes OR 5xx delta > 1.5% for 10 continuous minutes.
- Telemetry/audit: we will persist all routing changes, the triggering metric windows, and the pin action to your audit log (retained for 90 days) and generate a time-stamped remediation report.

I attached a short mitigation matrix that lays out thresholds and rollback windows. If that looks good, authorize us to enable the quarantine and auto-pin. We'll also open a ticket and loop in on-call infra to capture traces for the affected hosts.

Next steps:
1) Your OK to enable quarantine + auto-pin (reply-all).
2) We'll schedule a quick 30-min incident sync to review traces and confirm root cause approach.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Attachments: proposed-mitigation-matrix.pdf (pdf)
